text:
Maria Chen: quick question — I'm doing a last-minute check on /generate latency for the rollout. Where should I look for p50/p95/p99 TTFT and tokens/sec so I can tune alerts? pinging in case anyone has a pointer :eyes:
Samir Patel: grafana: use the 'inference-latency' dashboard + the 'route: /generate' variable. main panels: TTFT p50/p95/p99 and token-rate. link: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/inf_latency/inference-latency?orgId=1
Jordan V: PromQL snippets if helpful. TTFT p95 (histogram):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(ttft_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
```
Tokens/sec (aggregate per route):
```
sum(rate(tokens_generated_total[1m])) by (route)
```
Samir Patel: also check the 'hotshards' panel for queueing — a lot of apparent TTFT can be ruing off batching spikes.
Ryan H: if you want traces, hit Jaeger and search service=router and operation=/generate. example trace id I used earlier: `abc123def` — paste into jaeger URL: https://jaeger.redwood.com/trace/abc123def
Maria Chen: great, thanks. For alerts I saw p95 > 600ms firing often on the us-west cluster last night. Where should I propose the new thresholds?
Lisa K: put the proposal in the alerting rules PRs repo (infra/observability/alerts). My suggestion: for /generate (production): p95 > 700ms for 5m -> page, p95 > 500ms for 15m -> ticket. For tokens/sec drop (sudden) use a relative decline: drop > 40% over 2m for the route.
DevX Bot: reminder — opening an alert PR needs a test dashboard screenshot and a short rationale in the PR description.
Samir Patel: sample alert ALT-ttft-generate:
```yaml
alert: InferenceP95High_Generate
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(ttft_bucket[5m])) by (le, route)) > 0.7 and route=="/generate"
for: 5m
annotations:
  severity: page
  runbook: https://wiki.redwood.com/runbooks/ttft
```
Jordan V: small note — the prom expr needs route label selection in the sum, e.g. `sum by (le, route)(rate(ttft_bucket{route="/generate"}[5m]))` otherwise you'll get mixed routes.
Maria Chen: thanks Jordan. @Samir @Lisa can one of you review the alert PR when I open it? want to ship before EOD if possible.
Samir Patel: happy to review, will do it after standup :thumbsup:
Lisa K: I can review the thresholds and add the token-drop rule.
OpsBot: Deploy notice: grafana/dashboard-sync ran at 2026-03-17T09:12:22Z, job=dashboard-sync, status=ok
Ryan H: small debug tip — when hunting p99 spikes, filter by sequence_length and model; longer seqs will skew p99. use the 'seq_len' variable on the dashboard or add label `{seq_len=~"^.."}` in PromQL.
Maria Chen: perfect. I'll open the PR with screenshots + runbook link. Also leaving a note for oncall to mute the noisy p95 alert for us-west while we iterate.
DevX Bot: noted. Create a SNOOZE ticket in infra/observability/incidents with expected duration and owner.
Maria Chen: created: https://issues.redwood.com/INF-4212 — snooze p95 /generate for 2h while we test. tagging @Ops oncall.
Samir Patel: quick code-review ping: if folks see the PR, please prioritize — small change but impacts paging.
Lisa K: will take a look in ~30m.
Maria Chen: thanks all — action items: (1) Maria open alert PR with screenshots, (2) Samir + Lisa review, (3) Ops oncall apply snooze INF-4212, (4) Jordan to sanity-check PromQL snippets. I'll post final dashboard links in the PR. :raised_hands:
